records.title: Phase 5 Done when verified
records.body: {"role_test": "every route of the app refused for anonymous/guest/reader/script-guest where the policy says so; admins reach all admin routes; owner-only routes refuse admins", "cross_site": "reset-covers, reset-database, full-reset, reset-all-manual-actions refuse cross-site posts with the admin token"}

records.title: Forms sessions are HMAC-signed tokens with a per-account epoch; hashes are PBKDF2-SHA512 from the runtime
records.body: {"why": "no extra NuGet packages or DI changes (restore runs only in CI); sessions survive restarts; sign-out, password change and removal bump the epoch", "tradeoff": "sign-out ends all sessions of the account"}

records.title: Phase 5 audit: 9 findings, all fixed
records.body: {"fixed": ["upper-case path bypassed cross-site check and policy", "Remote-User trusted from any client", "throttle lockout and bypass", "sign-out kept sessions valid", "login open redirect", "Basic first boot impossible", "guest reads blocked by v1 filter", "AUTH_RESET_OWNER repeated and claimable by visitors", "token redaction, Secure cookie, password-change slow-down"]}
